[SWS_CRYPT_01806]
⌈
Calling the function CreateAuthCipherCtx of a
Crypto Provider shall return an instance of AuthCipherCtx identified by the pa-
rameter AlgId.
⌋

[SWS_CRYPT_01806]
⌈
The interface ara::crypto::cryp::Crypto-
Provider::CreateAuthCipherCtx shall return an instance of ara::crypto:-
:cryp::AuthCipherCtx implementing the algorithm specified by the provided pa-
rameter CryptoAlgId. The interface shall return
• kUnknownIdentifier, if the provided CryptoAlgId is not supported.
• kInvalidArgument, if the provided CryptoAlgId is supported but does not refer
to authenticated encryption/decryption.
⌋
